setup_steps.body:
1. Create (or fork) a small **Python** repository you own, with `pytest` tests that pass on `main`.
   Anything with 10 to 60 tests and some git history works; the E1 ranker reads the repository's own history.
2. Do not use a repository you do not own: the workflow writes comments with its token.
setup_steps.title: A sandbox repository

setup_steps.body:
Repository → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → **New repository secret**: `GROQ_API_KEY` = your Groq key.
Without it the bot still ranks, runs and triages, and says "No model is configured".
The model is `openai/gpt-oss-120b` (free tier, daily token cap); a run costs a few thousand tokens.
setup_steps.title: The Groq secret

setup_steps.body:
1. Copy `integrations/github-actions/blastradius-bot.yml` from this repository to
   `.github/workflows/blastradius-bot.yml` in the sandbox repository.
2. **Pin the tool**: replace `ref: upgrade-2.1` with a commit sha of `DeepanshuOP/blastradius`
   (`git rev-parse HEAD` in your clone) so the bot's behaviour does not change under you.
3. **Edit the dependency step** to install your repository the way it needs (the tests run inside BlastRadius's
   environment).
4. The workflow's permissions are `contents: read` and `pull-requests: write`; each line is explained in the file.
setup_steps.title: The workflow

workflow_yaml:
# BlastRadius PR bot (D-63, exploratory). Copy this file to .github/workflows/blastradius-bot.yml in the
# SANDBOX repository you own, then follow BOT_SETUP.md. It comments on pull requests; it never pushes,
# merges or approves.
name: blastradius-bot

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

# Least privilege, each line explained:
#   contents: read        check out the sandbox repository; the bot never writes to it.
#   pull-requests: write  create / edit its one comment and submit a review of inline suggestions.
# Nothing else is granted (no `contents: write`, so a push or merge is impossible with this token).
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: blastradius-bot-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  comment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Pull requests from forks get a read-only token and no secrets: the bot cannot run there.
    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    steps:
      - name: Check out the sandbox repository (full history, the E1 features read git history)
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check out BlastRadius at a pinned ref
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: DeepanshuOP/blastradius
          ref: 84a3a30ee0084565b44773412c104a86741f64a3   # pinned to this commit
          path: .blastradius-tool

      - name: Install uv and Python 3.11
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
      - run: uv python install 3.11

      - name: Install BlastRadius (graph extra for networkx, ml extra for the E1 and E2 models, rag extra for retrieval)
        working-directory: .blastradius-tool
        run: uv sync --extra graph --extra ml --extra rag

      - name: Install the sandbox repository's own dependencies into the same environment
        # EDIT THIS to the way your sandbox repository installs itself and its tests' dependencies.
        # pytest runs inside BlastRadius's environment, so the target must be importable there.
        working-directory: .blastradius-tool
        run: |
          uv pip install pytest
          if [ -f "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/requirements.txt" ]; then uv pip install -r "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/requirements.txt"; fi
          if [ -f "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/pyproject.toml" ]; then uv pip install -e "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"; fi

      - name: Run the bot
        working-directory: .blastradius-tool
        env:
          # Used only to edit / create the bot's comment (`pull-requests: write`) and read the PR files.
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # Groq free tier. Without it the bot still ranks, runs and triages; it just proposes no patch.
          GROQ_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GROQ_API_KEY }}
          BR_AGENT_PROVIDER: groq
          BR_AGENT_MODEL: openai/gpt-oss-120b
          # Every request and reply is cached here and uploaded below, so a run can be replayed offline.
          BR_LLM_CACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.blastradius-cache
        run: >
          uv run --extra graph --extra ml --extra rag python -m src.agents bot
          --repo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          --base ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          --head ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          --pr ${{ github.event.number }}

      - name: Upload the LLM cache and bot state
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: blastradius-bot-cache
          path: |
            .blastradius-cache
            .blastradius/reports
          include-hidden-files: true   # both paths are dot-directories; v4 skips those by default
          if-no-files-found: ignore
